entries.source: This yeti is somewhat smaller than the average yeti, and its fur seems well groomed. Nonetheless, it looks quite unhappy to see its master's home invaded.
entries.target: 这个雪人比一般的雪人要小一些，毛发似乎也经过精心梳理。不过，看到主人的家被入侵，它显得很不高兴。

entries.source: This yeti is large and angry, with claws far more sharply honed than those found in nature.
entries.target: 这个雪人体型巨大、怒气冲冲，它的爪子打磨得远比野生雪人的锋利。

entries.source: This yeti's claws are coated in sharply carved iron. It glares at you with a long trained anger.
entries.target: 这个雪人的爪子上套着锋利的铁刺，带着长期训练出的怒意恶狠狠地瞪着你。

entries.source: A swirling mass of hot vapour animated into a semblance of life.
entries.target: 一个看似有生命的灼热蒸汽漩涡。

entries.source: Oh. Oh no. Where did it get those?
entries.target: 哦。哦不。它是怎么弄到这些的？

entries.source:
#{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#Is that... a tree that cuts down trees?
Oh no don't worry. Only adventurers!#LAST##{normal}#
entries.target:
#{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#那是……一棵会砍树的树吗？
哦，不用担心。它只砍冒险者！#LAST##{normal}#

entries.source:
Ritches are giant insects native to the arid wastes of the southern parts of the Far East.
Vicious predators, they inject corrupting diseases into their foes, and their sharp claws cut through most armours.
entries.target:
里奇是原产于远东南部干旱地区的一种巨型昆虫。
它们是凶残的猎食者，会将腐败的疾病注入敌人体内，锋利的爪子能刺穿大部分盔甲。

entries.source: This strange creature looks like a ritch hunter but with more legs. So many legs.
entries.target: 这个奇怪的生物看上去像是一个里奇猎手，但是它的脚要多多了，多很多很多。

entries.source: The skin of this creature is literally crawling with larvae, yet she seems to be moving toward you very fast.
entries.target: 这个生物的皮肤上确确实实爬满了幼虫，但她似乎正飞快地向你逼近。
#{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#从某个过去的时代滑行而来……#LAST##{normal}#

entries.source: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. A huge clonking spider that runs to you at great speed ready to cut you to pieces with its two rotating saws in place of mandibles.
entries.target: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。它正向你飞速冲来并准备用颚部的旋转锯刃将你撕成碎片。

entries.source: The spirit of a recently deceased necropsych. It moans painfully but seems impervious to most worldly things.
entries.target: 这是一个近期死亡的通灵师的灵魂。它痛苦地哀鸣着，但似乎不受大多数凡俗之物影响。

entries.source: Covered in arcane runes of death, this steam giant means business.
entries.target: 这个被死亡符文所覆盖的蒸汽巨人是个大麻烦。

entries.source: #LIGHT_DARK#As %s falls you see its spirit rising for revenge.
entries.target: #LIGHT_DARK#当%s倒下时，你看到他的灵魂寻求复仇。

entries.source: Blood seems to ooze from the towering giant, yet seemingly to no ill effect.
entries.target: 尽管血液不停地从这个高大的巨人身上渗出，他看上去却没有任何不适。

entries.source: This steam giant is carrying a powerful looking gun.
entries.target: 这个蒸汽巨人拿着一把看上去威力很强的枪。

entries.source: This steam giant carries a steamgun in each hand.
entries.target: 这个蒸汽巨人双手各拿着一把蒸汽枪。

entries.source: This steam giant carries a steamgun in each hand. The barrels appear to be flaming.
entries.target: 这个蒸汽巨人双手各拿着一把枪管在燃烧的蒸汽枪。

entries.source: This steam giant carries a steamgun in each hand. She is here to eliminate any and all aggression towards the Atmos tribe.
entries.target: 这个蒸汽巨人双手各拿着一把蒸汽枪。她来此唯一的目的就是消灭任何对阿特姆斯部落的威胁。

entries.source: This titanic figure walks towards you, a massive sword and shield in each hand.
entries.target: 这个拿着巨型剑盾的庞大人形正在向你走来。

entries.source: This steam giant carries a massive greatsword with both hands, and you see a cloud of thick steam enveloping the blade.
entries.target: 这个蒸汽巨人双手拿着一柄无比庞大的大剑，你看到剑刃被厚厚的蒸汽云团包裹着。

entries.source: Riding atop a massive armored yeti, this steam giant wields a huge greatsword.
entries.target: 这个拿着大剑的蒸汽巨人骑在一只重甲雪人身上。

entries.source: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. A huge clonking spider that runs to you at great speed ready to cut you to pieces with its two rotating saws in place of mandibles.
entries.target: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。它正向你飞速冲来并准备用颚部的旋转锯刃将你撕成碎片。

entries.source: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. The huge flame thrower mounted on its back however is definitively un-spider-like.
entries.target: 这个八足机械构造体看起来很像蜘蛛，但背上安装的巨型火焰喷射器显然一点也不像蜘蛛该有的东西。

entries.source: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. An armed to the teeth, well, mandibles, spider.
entries.target: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。一个武装到牙齿，呃，颚部的蜘蛛。

entries.source: This eight legged mechanical construct looks suspiciously like a spider. It seems to be more concerned by its fellow arachnids than by you.
entries.target: 这是个看上去很像蜘蛛的八腿机械构造体。比起你，它似乎更关心它的同胞们。
